headline: Deezer will let listeners filter out AI-generated music
summary: Deezer announced a new toggle that lets listeners filter out AI-generated music entirely, with the feature set to roll out by the end of the year.

claims.statement: Deezer will let users filter out AI-generated music.

sources.quote: Deezer will soon let you filter out AI-generated music
Deezer will let listeners completely filter out AI music

sources.quote: the new toggle will be rolled out by the end of the year
